selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: At Maghrib time, what kind of being does the human spirit naturally long for according to the passage?
questions.answer: It longs for everlasting beauty and permanence.

questions.question: In this prayer, away from what does a person turn when saying that Allah is greater?
questions.answer: He turns away from passing things that do not last.

questions.question: Toward whom does a person direct himself in Maghrib prayer?
questions.answer: He directs himself to Allah, the Eternal Lord of might and power.

questions.question: What does praising Allah at the start of the prayer show about Him?
questions.answer: It shows that He is perfect, uniquely beautiful, and endlessly merciful.

questions.question: When a person says that only Allah is worshipped and only from Him help is sought, what is he admitting about Allah?
questions.answer: He is admitting that Allah alone deserves worship, rule, and reliance.

questions.question: What does bowing show about a human being in front of Allah’s greatness?
questions.answer: It shows human weakness, neediness, and lowliness before Allah’s majesty and power.

questions.question: What does prostration show about a person’s relationship with Allah?
questions.answer: It shows love, worship, humility, and amazement before Allah.

questions.question: What does the person leave behind when prostrating only to Allah?
questions.answer: He leaves everything besides Allah in his heart and focus.

questions.question: What does the passage say a person finds when he turns to Allah in this way?
questions.answer: He finds an Eternal and deeply Merciful Lord.

questions.question: Why does the prayer end with declaring Allah free from all faults and decline?
questions.answer: Because Allah is exalted above weakness, change, and any imperfection.

questions.question: What is the main movement of the heart at Maghrib prayer described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is turning from temporary things to Allah, who never dies or fades.

questions.question: Why are temporary things not enough for the human spirit in this passage?
questions.answer: Because the spirit seeks what is lasting, not what disappears.

questions.question: What does standing before Allah in prayer suggest about a person’s role?
questions.answer: It suggests that he stands as a servant before his Lord.

questions.question: Why is Allah praised after standing in prayer?
questions.answer: Because He has complete perfection, unmatched beauty, and vast mercy.

questions.question: What belief is expressed by seeking help only from Allah?
questions.answer: It expresses that true support comes only from Allah.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the whole universe with a person’s bowing?
questions.answer: It presents the person as joining all creation in admitting weakness before Allah.

questions.question: Which human feelings appear during prostration in the passage?
questions.answer: Wonder, love, worship, and humility appear.

questions.question: What stays constant in Allah while everything else passes away?
questions.answer: His Being, attributes, and perfection remain unchanged and everlasting.

questions.question: What does finding the All-Compassionate Eternal One mean for the worshipper?
questions.answer: It means he finds mercy, security, and someone truly lasting to turn to.

questions.question: How does the passage teach a Muslim to view Allah compared with the created world?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah alone is lasting and flawless, while the created world is passing and limited.

questions.question: What does the spirit do at Maghrib because of its natural desire for eternal beauty?
questions.answer: It turns its face toward Allah and away from created things that vanish.

questions.question: How is Allah described as different from the changing world in this passage?
questions.answer: He is living forever, enduring forever, and never lost or diminished.

questions.question: What does saying Allah is greater over passing things help a person do?
questions.answer: It helps him detach his heart from things that do not remain.

questions.question: In the prayer, what does clasping the hands in service show?
questions.answer: It shows devotion, respect, and readiness to obey Allah.
